•high health anxiety w/o sx; ruminate about a particular dz process + fear developing that illness
•A: preoccupation w/ having or acquiring a serious illness
•B: somatic sx not present or only mild; if another medical condition present or high risk (eg strong FHx), preoccupation clearly excessive/disproportionate
•C: high level of anxiety about health, easily alarmed about personal health status
•D: excessive health-related behaviors (eg repeatedly checks body for signs of illness) or maladaptive avoidance (eg avoids doctor appts + hospitals)
•E: preoccupation ≥6 mo, but the specific feared illness may change over that period
•F: not better explained by another mental d/o (somatic symptom d/o, panic d/o, GAD, body dysmorphic d/o, OCD, delusional d/o somatic type)
•Specify: care-seeking type (medical care incl visits + tests/procedures frequently used) vs care-avoidant type (medical care rarely used)
•differs from panic d/o: somatic sx are pervasive + persist longer than transient panic attacks
•A: ≥1 somatic sx causing distress or psychosocial impairment

•B: excessive thoughts, feelings, or behaviors assoc w/ the somatic sx, ≥1 of: persistent thoughts about the seriousness of the sx, persistent severe anxiety about the sx or general health, excessive time + energy devoted to the sx or health concerns
•C: although the specific sx may change, the d/o is persistent (usually >6 mo)

•Qualifiers: w/ predominant pain; severity = mild (1 feature of B) / moderate (≥2) / severe (≥2 + multiple somatic concerns eg fatigue, dizziness, GI distress, or 1 very severe sx); persistent = course >6 mo + psychosocial functioning markedly impaired + severity rated severe
